# Precision for Medicine Biospecimens: Remarkable Selection and Quality

Biospecimens product, solutions and services curated to advance precision therapeutic and diagnostic
development Request a quote

Precision for Medicine has built one of the world’s most extensive biobanks and sample collection
networks, capable of meeting the stringent needs of any disease research program. 

In addition to biorepositories containing over 10 million specimens, Precision has thousands of
IRB-approved, clinically-annotated biospecimens ready to ship to your lab with deeply-characterized
inventories across major therapeutic indications.

## From Discovery to Development, Start with the Right Specimen

Extensive clinical annotations, multiple quality certifications, ready-to-ship inventory, and global
sourcing capabilities. **Oncology, rare disease, immunology, and more.**

Order now

## Supporting research with a robust biospecimens inventory along with custom collections

Precision for Medicine has built both a world-class biorepository containing millions of specimens,
and a global infrastructure to collect biospecimens we may not have readily available.

[37]

### Precision's Biorepositories

##### Precise cohorts of data-rich, research-ready specimens to fuel your studies.

Precision's biorepositories contain millions of readily available tissue and liquid biospecimens.
* Most specimen types and volumes
* Matched specimens available
* Associated data may include:
  * Medical history & comorbidities
  * Demographics & lifestyle
  * Longitudinal data
  * Serological and molecular profiling

[donor-pfm]

### Custom Collections

We have developed an international network of hospitals, clinical care centers & specialty
laboratories to perform custom collections from both healthy and disease-state donors.
* Custom collection plan development and full service execution: recruitment, kitting, sample
  collection, and logistics
* Extensive capabilities for storage, testing, analysis and more

[ Explore custom collections ][162]

## Capabilities designed to deliver the highest quality biospecimens

Our capabilities extend beyond an inventory of high-quality biospecimens. A exceptional suite of
collection services, custom processing capabilities, and specialty assay services to characterize
and annotate specimens allow us to provide biospecimens precisely tailored to the needs of your
research.
* Integrated Processing Lab
* Pathology Services
* Advanced Characterized Specimens

  center can rapidly perform processing ranging from the routine such as PBMC creation, to flow
  cytometry profiling of immune cell subsets

# Precision for Medicine Biospecimens: Remarkable Selection and Quality

Biospecimens product, solutions and services curated to advance precision therapeutic and diagnostic
development Request a quote

Precision for Medicine has built one of the world’s most extensive biobanks and sample collection
networks, capable of meeting the stringent needs of any disease research program. 

In addition to biorepositories containing over 10 million specimens, Precision has thousands of
IRB-approved, clinically-annotated biospecimens ready to ship to your lab with deeply-characterized
inventories across major therapeutic indications.

## From Discovery to Development, Start with the Right Specimen

Extensive clinical annotations, multiple quality certifications, ready-to-ship inventory, and global
sourcing capabilities. **Oncology, rare disease, immunology, and more.**

## Supporting research with a robust biospecimens inventory along with custom collections

Precision for Medicine has built both a world-class biorepository containing millions of specimens,
and a global infrastructure to collect biospecimens we may not have readily available.

### Precision's Biorepositories

##### Precise cohorts of data-rich, research-ready specimens to fuel your studies.

Precision's biorepositories contain millions of readily available tissue and liquid biospecimens.
* Most specimen types and volumes
* Matched specimens available
* Associated data may include:
  * Medical history & comorbidities
  * Demographics & lifestyle
  * Longitudinal data
  * Serological and molecular profiling

[donor-pfm]

### Custom Collections

We have developed an international network of hospitals, clinical care centers & specialty
laboratories to perform custom collections from both healthy and disease-state donors.
* Custom collection plan development and full service execution: recruitment, kitting, sample
  collection, and logistics
* Extensive capabilities for storage, testing, analysis and more

[ Explore custom collections ][162]

## Capabilities designed to deliver the highest quality biospecimens

Our capabilities extend beyond an inventory of high-quality biospecimens. A exceptional suite of
collection services, custom processing capabilities, and specialty assay services to characterize
and annotate specimens allow us to provide biospecimens precisely tailored to the needs of your
research.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]
[Labcorp biopharma technician evaluating samples]

Labcorp OnDemand

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

[ Shop All Tests ][223]

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path

[ Learn More ][221]

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

We make your process simpler, faster, and more sustainable. We’re in this together. For better

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

How we think differently

## Most CROs list what they do. We map what's happening to your drug.

Every engagement starts with the biology — not the assay menu. We follow the cascade your
therapeutic creates and work backwards to the measurement strategy that captures the critical
events.

01

#### Causality, not a checklist

One biological event leads to the next. LNP uptake precedes translation. Translation precedes ADA
formation. ADA formation precedes neutralization. We design measurement programs that follow the
chain — so no signal goes undetected because it wasn’t on the SOW.

02

#### Phase-intelligent from day one

What you need to measure in a rat biodistribution study is different from a Phase 2 patient cohort.
We scope every program with the end phase in mind — so the assay developed preclinically is the same
one your regulator sees in your BLA.

03

#### Regulatory framework matched to your stage

RUO for discovery. Fit-for-purpose for early clinical. GLP, CAP, or CLIA when your program demands
it. We don’t force every study into the same compliance box — we match the framework to where you
are.

04

#### Long-term monitoring builds partnerships

Phase 2 and beyond generate longitudinal samples that require consistent, credible measurement over
years. Our CAP/CLIA infrastructure and biobanking strategy are built for exactly this arc.

## "One trusted scientific partner — from your first preclinical question to your last patient
## visit."
## 
## One conversation with a scientist who understands your program from the inside.

[ Contact Us ][90]
By development phase

## The measurement strategy evolves with you.

The biological cascade changes at each phase — and so should the measurement strategy that captures
it.

PRECLINICAL

#### Preclinical — Assay Development & Bioanalytical Support

Building the right assays — and generating the early data — before the biology gets complex.
* Assay development & fit-for-purpose validation across modalities (biologics, cell & gene,
  vaccines, small molecules)
* PK, ADA & exploratory biomarker analysis on animal-study samples
* Ex vivo mechanism-of-action & innate-immune readouts

PHASE 1

#### Clinical Validation & Biomarker Discovery

Translating preclinical methods to GLP/clinical-grade in real human matrices — while standing up the
exploratory assays that surface tomorrow’s endpoints.
* Validated tiered ADA / NAb & clinical PK by LBA
* Exploratory biomarker discovery & assay development
* Safety & immunogenicity panels

PHASE 2

#### Qualified Endpoints & Longitudinal Consistency

Maturing exploratory assays into qualified, validated endpoints — and holding measurement consistent
across larger cohorts and longer timelines.
* Translating exploratory assays into qualified, validated endpoints
* Functional immunology & biomarker measurement
* CAP / CLIA reporting, biobanking & sample integrity

PHASE 3

#### Registration-Grade Data & Submission Readiness

Fully validated, registration-grade data packages built for regulatory submission — and a
partnership ready to carry methods into post-approval.
* Registration-grade, fully validated assays (ICH M10)
* Cross-study harmonization & assay bridging
* Regulatory-ready data packages for BLA / NDA submission

Inside the lab

## Purpose-built infrastructure.
## Master-level execution.

CAP/CLIA-certified, BSL-2 capable laboratories — directly run by senior bioanalytical scientists. No
hand-offs to a queue, no PhD on a coversheet who never touches your data.

### 15,000+

Samples processed annually

### BSL-2

Certified facility

### 100%

Scientist-run, no hand-offs

Accelevir laboratory · Baltimore, MD
By therapeutic modality

## Each modality has its own cascade.

The biological events differ across RNA, gene, cell, protein, and vaccine programs — and so does the
measurement strategy each one demands.

[RNA Therapeutics]

#### RNA Therapeutics

LNP delivery efficiency, expressed-protein PK, innate-immune activation, and ADA/NAb — measured
along the full delivery-to-expression chain.
* LNP uptake
* Expressed-protein PK
* ADA / NAb

[ View cascade ][91]
[Gene Therapy (AAV / LV)]

#### Gene Therapy (AAV / LV)

Capsid immunogenicity, transduction efficiency, biodistribution, and anti-AAV neutralizing
antibodies across the vector lifecycle.
* Capsid NAb
* Transduction
* Biodistribution

[ View cascade ][92]
[Cell Therapy (CAR-T / TCR-T / NK)]

#### Cell Therapy (CAR-T / TCR-T / NK)

Persistence, phenotype, cytokine storm and CRS monitoring, plus anti-CAR antibodies — measured
longitudinally as the product engrafts.
* Persistence
* CRS panel
* Phenotype

[ View cascade ][93]
[Protein Biologics & ADCs]

#### Protein Biologics & ADCs

ADA tiered platform, PK by LBA, neutralizing antibodies, and functional immunology biomarkers for
antibody and conjugate programs.
* ADA tiered
* PK LBA
* Functional

[ View cascade ][94]
[Vaccines & Infectious Disease]

#### Vaccines & Infectious Disease

Viral load, pathogen quantification and sequencing, neutralizing antibodies, T-cell response, and
PBMC-based functional readouts.
* Viral load
* T-cell response
* PBMC

[ View cascade ][95]
Not sure where you fit?

#### Map your program's cascade with a scientist.

Bring your modality and phase — we’ll show you exactly which biological events to measure and when.

[ Start a Program Assessment ][96]
Core capabilities

## Six service lines. One integrated measurement platform.

Each capability covers a distinct arc of the biological cascade — and runs on shared samples, shared
data, and shared scientists.

Immunogenicity suite

How we think differently

## Most CROs list what they do. We map what's happening to your drug.

Every engagement starts with the biology — not the assay menu. We follow the cascade your
therapeutic creates and work backwards to the measurement strategy that captures the critical
events.

01

#### Causality, not a checklist

One biological event leads to the next. LNP uptake precedes translation. Translation precedes ADA
formation. ADA formation precedes neutralization. We design measurement programs that follow the
chain — so no signal goes undetected because it wasn’t on the SOW.

02

#### Phase-intelligent from day one

What you need to measure in a rat biodistribution study is different from a Phase 2 patient cohort.
We scope every program with the end phase in mind — so the assay developed preclinically is the same
one your regulator sees in your BLA.

03

#### Regulatory framework matched to your stage

RUO for discovery. Fit-for-purpose for early clinical. GLP, CAP, or CLIA when your program demands
it. We don’t force every study into the same compliance box — we match the framework to where you
are.

04

#### Long-term monitoring builds partnerships

Phase 2 and beyond generate longitudinal samples that require consistent, credible measurement over
years. Our CAP/CLIA infrastructure and biobanking strategy are built for exactly this arc.

## What is Cryonics?

Cryonics is one of the world’s most ambitious scientific experiments – a bold attempt to preserve
human life once current medicine has reached its limits. By preserving the physical structures that
store our memories, personality, and identity, cryonics aims to safeguard each patient until future
medical progress overcomes today’s limitations.

## How it Works

Cryonics begins at the moment of legal passing, once conventional medical science offers no
remaining options. Specialized teams work swiftly to protect and stabilize the patient, slowing the
biological processes that would otherwise lead to rapid deterioration. Through careful cooling and
the introduction of unique cryoprotective solutions, the delicate architecture of life is preserved
in a state of biological stasis. Patients are then cared for indefinitely, until future medical
breakthroughs enable the possibility for restoration and repair.

[MikePerryinPatientCareBay-e1756847523722][MikePerryinPatientCareBay-e1756847523722]

With over half a century of experience, Alcor stands as the world’s premier cryonics organization.
Our comprehensive approach encompasses advanced preservation technologies, dedicated member
services, elite deployment and recovery teams (DART), and secure long-term care – all backed by
dedicated financial safeguards and world-class research capabilities. Our integrated approach
delivers the most reliable and technologically advanced services available anywhere in the world.

## What is Cryonics?

Cryonics is one of the world’s most ambitious scientific experiments – a bold attempt to preserve
human life once current medicine has reached its limits. By preserving the physical structures that
store our memories, personality, and identity, cryonics aims to safeguard each patient until future
medical progress overcomes today’s limitations.

## How it Works

Cryonics begins at the moment of legal passing, once conventional medical science offers no
remaining options. Specialized teams work swiftly to protect and stabilize the patient, slowing the
biological processes that would otherwise lead to rapid deterioration. Through careful cooling and
the introduction of unique cryoprotective solutions, the delicate architecture of life is preserved
in a state of biological stasis. Patients are then cared for indefinitely, until future medical
breakthroughs enable the possibility for restoration and repair.

Our comprehensive approach encompasses advanced preservation technologies, dedicated member
services, elite deployment and recovery teams (DART), and secure long-term care – all backed by
dedicated financial safeguards and world-class research capabilities. Our integrated approach
delivers the most reliable and technologically advanced services available anywhere in the world.

## Alcor FAQs

What is the core difference between Alcor and other providers?

Alcor combines 24/7 medical readiness and in-house R&D with a dedicated Patient Care Trust that
funds perpetual care. That integration of immediate capability, continuous innovation, and legally
protected long-term stewardship sets us apart from other providers.

[Learn more here!][90]

Why did you choose the name Alcor?

In September of 1970, Linda and Fred Chamberlain, the founders of Alcor believed that people would
someday travel to the stars. Fred searched through star catalogs and astronomy books, hoping to find
a star that could serve as a fitting name for a cryonics organization. Alcor, a dim star near the
bright star Mizar, has been used for centuries as a test for good eyesight. If you can see the goals
and purpose of Alcor, you have excellent focus and vision.

[**Learn more here!**][91]

Is Alcor a non-profit organization?

Alcor is a 501(c)(3) scientific and educational non-profit organization. To be tax-exempt under
section 501(c)(3) of the [Internal Revenue Code][92], an organization must be organized and operated
exclusively for exempt purposes set forth in section 501(c)(3), and none of its earnings may benefit
any private shareholder or individual. Non-profit organizations do not have shareholders who would
be able to change Alcor’s Mission Statement to a purpose other than the benefit of the patients.

New slide

Altogen Labs provides over 50 xenograft cancer animal models (biodistribution, PK/PD, imaging
studies). We offer assistance in choosing the best model suitable for clients experimental goals.
Animal handling and maintenance at our facility is IACUC-regulated and GLP-compliant. We provide
detailed experiment procedures, health reports and experimental data.

Xenograft Animal Service
New slide

Altogen Labs provides A-to-Z RNAi in vivo delivery services: custom si/miRNA liposome encapsulation,
chemical modification, in vitro validation, in vivo tissue-targeted delivery. Assays include:
oligonucleotide accumulation (TaqMan), target mRNA (RT-PCR) and protein expression levels (WB and
ELISA).

In Vivo siRNA Delivery
New slide

Stable cell lines over-expressing a protein of interest, or RNAi construct targeting a gene of
interest, are powerful research tools for the production of recombinant antibodies, drug screening,
and gene function studies. Altogen Labs provides service of stable cell line development completed
in 28 days.

research services for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and academic institutions worldwide. We provide
biology CRO *in vivo* services, including 98 in-house validated CDX models, 47 PDX xenograft models,

Altogen Labs provides over 50 xenograft cancer animal models (biodistribution, PK/PD, imaging

Animal handling and maintenance at our facility is IACUC-regulated and GLP-compliant. We provide

Xenograft Animal Service
New slide

Altogen Labs provides A-to-Z RNAi in vivo delivery services: custom si/miRNA liposome encapsulation,
chemical modification, in vitro validation, in vivo tissue-targeted delivery. Assays include:
oligonucleotide accumulation (TaqMan), target mRNA (RT-PCR) and protein expression levels (WB and
ELISA).

In Vivo siRNA Delivery
New slide

Stable cell lines over-expressing a protein of interest, or RNAi construct targeting a gene of
interest, are powerful research tools for the production of recombinant antibodies, drug screening,
and gene function studies. Altogen Labs provides service of stable cell line development completed
in 28 days.

Through targeted acquisitions and our own internal research and development efforts, ATCC provides
the authenticated, cutting-edge products you need to make incredible discoveries.

[Explore new products][27]
[ [Scientists Working in The Laboratory iStock-1181391587.jpg] ][28]

Explore our coming soon products for a preview of what our team is developing for diagnostics
development, drug discovery, toxicology profiling, analytical testing, and more. 

[See what's coming next][29]

 

ATCC (American Type Culture Collection) is a nonprofit, global biological resource center and
standards organization and the leading developer and supplier of authenticated cells lines and
microorganisms. We leverage our rich history and knowledge to provide the products, services, and
resources scientists need to conduct critical life science research.

  ### Product Feature: Disappearing Call Logs

  belongs to you and you alone. Cape minimized retention of call and text logs, deleting them after

  additional real phone numbers included in their plan.

# **De-Risk & Accelerate Your Journey To The Clinic With Your Cell Therapy CDMO Partner**

We support academic laboratories, biotechs, and pharma companies through development and GMP
challenges. Hands-on expertise, clear communication, and a genuine commitment to your success. Less
uncertainty. Faster timelines. A cell therapy CDMO partner you can rely on.

[Let’s talk about your project][17]

1000+

Clinical doses

manufactured in our GMP facility

15

Cell Types handled

T cells, NK cells, T regs, MSCs, iPS, immortalized cell lines…

50+

Development Programs

Process Development, Optimization, Scale up, Analytical & Potency test development

## White Paper: From Bench to GMP: Building a Robust Manufacturing Process for Cell Therapies.

Great science is only the beginning. Discover why robust, scalable, and GMP-ready manufacturing
processes have become critical to securing funding, accelerating development, and bringing cell
therapies to patients. This white paper highlights the key strategies that transform promising
research into investable and clinically viable products.

[Read the White Paper – Nouvelle fenêtre][18]
[Knowledge center][19]
[From Bench to GMP_Cell-Easy]
[Cell-Based Therapies Are Not Conventional Drugs. They’re Living Treatments.]

## Cell-Based Therapies Are Not Conventional Drugs. They’re Living Treatments.

Cell therapy programs don’t usually fail because of bad science, they fail because of execution
gaps: [processes][20] that aren’t robust enough to scale, documentation that doesn’t hold up to
regulatory scrutiny, and timelines that slip the moment complexity increases. As a **cell therapy
CDMO**, closing these gaps is our core expertise. We bring the technical depth and manufacturing
rigor needed to keep your program on track from early development through clinical success.

### **Broad Expertise Across Cell Therapy Modalities**

Autologous and allogeneic, engineered (CAR/TCR) and non-engineered — including T-cells, NK cells,
**mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs)**, and iPSCs. Whatever your cell type, we’ve likely already solved a
similar challenge.

### **Platform-Agnostic Cell Therapy Manufacturing**

We operate independently of any specific platform or system, allowing us to adapt to your existing
**technologies** and **processes**

### **Built for Regulatory Scrutiny**

We ensure regulatory compliance at every stage, following **ICH Q2 (R1)**, **European
Pharmacopeia**, **EMA/MHRA**, and** US Pharmacopeia **standards, with a proven track record of
**successful audits**.

De-Risk your project

## White Paper: From Bench to GMP: Building a Robust Manufacturing Process for Cell Therapies.

Great science is only the beginning. Discover why robust, scalable, and GMP-ready manufacturing
processes have become critical to securing funding, accelerating development, and bringing cell
therapies to patients. This white paper highlights the key strategies that transform promising
research into investable and clinically viable products.

[Cell-Based Therapies Are Not Conventional Drugs. They’re Living Treatments.]

## Cell-Based Therapies Are Not Conventional Drugs. They’re Living Treatments.

Cell therapy programs don’t usually fail because of bad science, they fail because of execution
gaps: [processes][20] that aren’t robust enough to scale, documentation that doesn’t hold up to
regulatory scrutiny, and timelines that slip the moment complexity increases. As a **cell therapy
CDMO**, closing these gaps is our core expertise. We bring the technical depth and manufacturing
rigor needed to keep your program on track from early development through clinical success.

### **Broad Expertise Across Cell Therapy Modalities**

Autologous and allogeneic, engineered (CAR/TCR) and non-engineered — including T-cells, NK cells,
**mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs)**, and iPSCs. Whatever your cell type, we’ve likely already solved a
similar challenge.

### **Platform-Agnostic Cell Therapy Manufacturing**

We operate independently of any specific platform or system, allowing us to adapt to your existing
**technologies** and **processes**

### **Built for Regulatory Scrutiny**

We ensure regulatory compliance at every stage, following **ICH Q2 (R1)**, **European
Pharmacopeia**, **EMA/MHRA**, and** US Pharmacopeia **standards, with a proven track record of
**successful audits**.

**Celularity Inc.** (NASDAQ: CELU) is an innovative regenerative and cellular medicine company. It
is developing and commercializing advanced biomaterial products and allogeneic, cryopreserved, cell
therapies, all derived from the postpartum placenta to target age-related diseases. Celularity’s
proprietary approach, harnessing the placenta’s unique biology and ready availability, is paving the
way for therapeutic solutions that address significant unmet global needs for effective, accessible,
and affordable therapies.

With greater expandability, persistence, and stem-ness

## cellular therapies, at unparalleled scale, quality, and economics

* Unmet Global Need
  Significant unmet global need for allogeneic cellular medicines delivered on-demand, off-the-shelf
* Groundbreaking Research
  Groundbreaking basic & translational research into the unique biological activity of
  placental-derived cells
* Pioneering Technology
  Pioneering technology platform of placental-derived cellular medicines and advanced biomaterials
* Industry Timing
  The time has arrived for cellular medicines that overcome barriers of scale, quality, and
  economics

[COMPANY PIPELINE][31]

Cellular Medicine Manufacturing

## The Process is the Product

**A fully integrated, purpose-built manufacturing, translational research and biobanking center**
* Purpose-built facility staffed by over 100 highly specialized scientists, engineers & technicians
* 150,000 sq ft including laboratory and advanced manufacturing space for cellular medicine &
  biomaterials
* Clinical Scale – (9) Grade C/ISO 7 suites and (6) Grade D/ISO 8 labs **ALL GMP-CAPABLE**

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

LOTS Wholesale Solutions, a leading business-to-business wholesaler in India is focused on providing
a one-stop-shop solution for its valued customers. LOTS has been serving its registered members
including Retailers HoReCa (Hotels, Restaurants, caterings) and service providers in Delhi NCR.
Currently, the company operates through 5 physical stores, a microhub & an E-com portal in North
India.

To provide the best customer service, the brand is using perfect blending technology with a
personalised touch and facilitates an immersive offline-to-online (O2O) experience.

stores** in Delhi NCR.

The brand ethos and 3-C philosophy hinge on the premise of creating MORE VALUE for the country, the
community and the company through excellent customer experiences.

LOTS stores are **HACCP** certified and follows government norms of food safety standards and
quality control.

LOTS Wholesale Solutions, a leading business-to-business wholesaler in India is focused on providing
a one-stop-shop solution for its valued customers. LOTS has been serving its registered members

# Specialist Clinical Trials, Biological, Cell & Gene Therapies Depot Services

### Bridging the gap between medical research and your logistical needs

[ About us ][50]

### Clinical Trial Logistics

Specialised outsourced clinical trial logistics services

[Learn more][51]

### Biological Storage

Harnessing the potential of biological therapies

[Learn more][52]

### Cell & Gene Therapies Depot services

Delivering the potential of cell & gene therapies

[Learn more][53]
[Cryo in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia]
[Cryo in Australia]

##### Cryosite

## An Australian Clinical Trials, Biological, Cell & Gene Therapies Depot.

In the highly regulated, complicated, [clinical trials][54], [biological][55], [cell & Gene
Therapies][56] environments, our mission is simple: we take care of your storage, chain of custody,
returns, transport and logistics needs so you can concentrate on your core objectives. Cryosite’s
team has the experience and ability to support you during every stage of the [clinical trials][57],
[biological][58], [cell & Gene Therapies][59] processes. Our professionalism assures risk is
minimised, confidentiality is maintained and compliance, regulatory and logistics are seamless.

### Trust

Cryosite, a pioneer in the field, was granted its license as the first private cord blood bank in
Australia back in 2000. Over the years, we have proudly maintained our position as a trusted leader
in cord blood, stem cell, biological, and clinical trials depot services. Our enduring commitment to
compliance reliability, and expertise is a testament to the trust our clients have placed in us for
over two decades.

### Quality

Cryosite uses state-of-the-art technology, quality management systems and a highly experienced team
to maintain the value of stored samples in our fully monitored facility.

### Hope

By storing samples with Cryosite, you benefit from greatly increased options and opportunities in
harnessing the potential of today's treatments, and benefiting from tomorrow's research
breakthroughs.

[ More About Us ][60]

## We value your trust
## We are dedicated to quality
## Storing for tomorrow’s opportunities

##### Clinical Trials Services

## Who We Are

Cryosite is a unique Australian company and a world-class specialist in providing outsourced
clinical trials depot services.

Established in 2000, Cryosite is highly experienced in in clinical trial logistics. Our team is
comprised of highly qualified scientists and clinical trials experts who ensure complex clinical
trials are conducted with seamless efficiency and safety.

We manage the entire [clinical trial supply chain][61] from importation, receipt, specialised
ambient, cold, frozen, and [liquid nitrogen storage][62] for temperature-sensitive products,
distribution and reverse logistics management.

Cryosite’s third party depot services are professional, reliable and compliant; our people are
experts in their respective fields and are approachable, ethical and responsive to clients’ needs.

## Our Partnerships

[csr]
[Print]

Contact Our Dedicated Team

Cryosite are the pioneers for private cord blood storage in Australia and we have been trusted to
store temperature-sensitive samples since 2000.
[ Contact Us ][63]

Cryosite was established with the specific objective of providing specialised clinical trials depot
services to a wide range of clients from the research, medical, pharmaceutical and biotechnology
industries.

In the highly regulated, complicated, clinical trial environment, our mission is simple: we take
care of your warehousing, distribution and logistics needs so you can concentrate on your core
objectives.

##### Cryosite

## An Australian Clinical Trials, Biological, Cell & Gene Therapies Depot.

In the highly regulated, complicated, [clinical trials][54], [biological][55], [cell & Gene
Therapies][56] environments, our mission is simple: we take care of your storage, chain of custody,
returns, transport and logistics needs so you can concentrate on your core objectives. Cryosite’s
team has the experience and ability to support you during every stage of the [clinical trials][57],
[biological][58], [cell & Gene Therapies][59] processes. Our professionalism assures risk is
minimised, confidentiality is maintained and compliance, regulatory and logistics are seamless.

### Trust

Cryosite, a pioneer in the field, was granted its license as the first private cord blood bank in
Australia back in 2000. Over the years, we have proudly maintained our position as a trusted leader
in cord blood, stem cell, biological, and clinical trials depot services. Our enduring commitment to
compliance reliability, and expertise is a testament to the trust our clients have placed in us for
over two decades.

### Quality

Cryosite uses state-of-the-art technology, quality management systems and a highly experienced team
to maintain the value of stored samples in our fully monitored facility.

### Hope

By storing samples with Cryosite, you benefit from greatly increased options and opportunities in
harnessing the potential of today's treatments, and benefiting from tomorrow's research
breakthroughs.

## Who We Are

Cryosite is a unique Australian company and a world-class specialist in providing outsourced
clinical trials depot services.

Established in 2000, Cryosite is highly experienced in in clinical trial logistics. Our team is
comprised of highly qualified scientists and clinical trials experts who ensure complex clinical
trials are conducted with seamless efficiency and safety.

We manage the entire [clinical trial supply chain][61] from importation, receipt, specialised
ambient, cold, frozen, and [liquid nitrogen storage][62] for temperature-sensitive products,
distribution and reverse logistics management.

Cryosite’s third party depot services are professional, reliable and compliant; our people are

  If you have no credit history or have struggled with your credit in the past, a Discover credit
  card might be a good card for you. If you're a student with [no credit history][78], compare our

  Discover is part of Capital One. [Learn more][80] about how you can bank your way with accounts
  that fit your lifestyle-that means no fees and no minimums.

  Making a [balance transfer][81] is a great way to save money on higher interest debt. See all the
  ways we can help you achieve your [debt consolidation goals][82].

  afford a large purchase. $0 origination fees, a fixed monthly payment and no prepayment penalty.
  Estimate your payments today with our [personal loan calculator.][84]

  Discover no longer offers or services student loans. For assistance call 1-800-211-9112.

##### [find out how][34]

Leanbio is a global CDMO providing development and manufacturing services for biopharmaceutical
products as new biological entities and biosimilars.

Since our foundation in 2014, we specialize in efficient processes through our commitment to
precision and technical skills for innovative, reliable bio-manufacturing solutions that ensure the
successful delivery of our clients’ projects.

##### Offerings

## Customized CDMO services in Microbial, Mammalian, pDNA and mRNA

We can offe three technological platforms to help streamline the navigation of your bioprocessing.
From cell line development to manufacturing. Our platforms can be applied to different expression
systems like E.coli, CHO, and Pichia Pastoris.

### [Mammalian][35]

### [Microbial][36]

## Since 2014, at Leanbio we embrace lean thinking to enhance efficiency in biopharma. Focused

##### COMPANY

For the last 10 years, Leanbio has been providing end-to-end development and manufacturing services,
for biotech start ups and Pharmaceutical companies.

With new GMP facilities coming on Q4 2025, we are willing to become your trusted partner in
Barcelona, crafting your products future. Your vision is our expertise.

## Leanbio is composed by a talented, young, motivated and interdisciplinary team of scientists

With only one decade on biopharma expertise, Leanbio has already been successfully shepherded 100
molecules from proof of concept to advanced clinical stages.

# Payments, tax & subscriptions for software companies

Selling digital downloads, subscriptions, and software licenses has never been easier, faster, or
more secure.

[
Get started
][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

ecommerce

## Create the perfect buying experience for your customers

Launch your secure ecommerce website and start selling software, subscriptions and digital downloads
anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

[
e/1

### Accept online payments

Don't worry about merchant accounts and billing logic. **Choose per seat, usage-based and more**.
Customize as little or as much as you like.

][33][
e/2

### Recurring billing + subscriptions

Charge customers on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. **Manage upgrades, downgrades, and
cancels**. Offer free trials, discounts, and more.

][34][
e/3

### License key management

Automatically issue license keys for your software and apps after each sale. **Deactivate, re-issue,
and have full control** over license management.

][35][
e/4

### Sell digital downloads

Anyone can provide download links, but what about security and abuse? Your **download links are
securely signed**, throttled, and more.

][36][
e/5

### No-code checkout forms

No matter what you use for your website, you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique
checkout links** and sell anywhere.

][37][
e/6

### Launch your ecommerce store

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured
and mobile-optimized as standard.

][38]
marketing

## Grow your business with integrated marketing tools

Grow your audience, build long-lasting customer relationships, and make more sales with **powerful,
easy-to-use marketing tools**. Whether you need to offer discount codes or you want to build your
email list, you can do it all with Lemon Squeezy.

[

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

Biologics & CGT Testing

## Minaris Advanced Testing

Standalone or integrated GMP testing across all biologics modalities, performed in our dedicated
140,000 ft² Philadelphia facility. With over 40 years of experience, we support cell therapies,
viral vectors, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, and vaccines with rapid,
regulator-accepted results.

Need standalone or integrated testing?

[ Explore Testing Services ][81]
* Analytical Development
  
  Our analytical scientists design, optimize and validate assays across the full lifecycle, from
  early-phase methods to commercial readiness. Services include potency, purity, identity and
  stability testing, aligned with ICH Q2 and global regulatory expectations. Integrated with
  development and manufacturing, we ensure reliable GMP performance across all modalities.
  
  [ Learn About Analytical Development ][82]
  1 / 8
* Assay Transfer
  
  Smooth assay transfer ensures continuity and reliability across sites and studies, maintaining
  consistency and accuracy. We deliver structured, data-driven transfers, including gap analysis,
  bridging studies and qualification/validation, in accordance with ICH Q2. Methods are supported
  across viral vectors, gene-edited cells, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), proteins and vaccines,
  ensuring seamless readiness for lot release, stability and comparability studies.
  
  [ See Assay Transfer Support ][83]
  2 / 8
* Biosafety Testing
  
  With more than 40 years of biosafety expertise, Minaris provides GMP-compliant sterility,
  mycoplasma, endotoxin, adventitious agent and replication-competent virus testing. Our specialized
  focus on CGT ensures risk-based strategies tailored to viral vectors, plasmids and packaging
  systems. Results are audit-ready and regulator-accepted, supporting IND, IMPD and BLA submissions
  worldwide.
  
  [ Explore Biosafety Testing ][84]
  3 / 8
* Cell Line Characterization
  
  We provide comprehensive, regulatory-compliant characterization of Master, Working and
  End-of-Production Cell Banks, including sterility, mycoplasma, endotoxin, retroviral and identity
  testing. Our services align with the guidelines of the ICH, FDA, EMA and PMDA, enabling the faster
  release of GMP cell banks and seamless integration into development and manufacturing workflows.
  
  [ Learn About Cell Line Characterization ][85]
  4 / 8
* Lot Release
  
  A reliable lot release ensures that therapies reach patients without delay. Minaris provides a
  comprehensive GMP testing panel across various modalities, including sterility, identity, potency,
  purity, residuals, RCL/rcAAV and more. With thousands of batches tested, our validated assays
  support global submissions and commercial approvals, minimizing risk and accelerating patient
  access.
  
  [ See Lot Release ][86]
  5 / 8
* Potency
  
  Potency is a critical quality attribute. We design and validate custom assays, ranging from
  cell-based functional studies and reporter gene assays to ELISA, PCR and transduction efficiency
  tests. All assays meet ICH Q2 standards, providing meaningful biological insights that satisfy
  regulators and support product release and lifecycle management.
  
  [ Explore Potency ][87]
  6 / 8
* Stability
  
  We deliver ICH Q1-compliant stability programs, including long-term, real-time, accelerated and
  ongoing studies. Our methods support all biologic and advanced therapy modalities, with
  submission-ready data for global regulators. By evaluating shelf life and storage conditions, we
  ensure that therapies maintain their safety, quality and efficacy throughout distribution and
  patient use.
  
  [ Learn About Stability ][88]
  7 / 8
* Viral Clearance
  
  A global leader with 3,000+ studies and zero regulatory rejections, Minaris designs viral
  clearance studies aligned with ICH Q5A(R2), FDA, EMA and WHO guidelines. Dedicated viral clearance
  suites with AKTA systems ensure rigorous validation across vectors, proteins and vaccines,
  safeguarding patient safety and accelerating regulatory approvals.
  
  [ See Viral Clearance ][89]
  8 / 8

## Minaris Advanced Testing

Standalone or integrated GMP testing across all biologics modalities, performed in our dedicated
140,000 ft² Philadelphia facility. With over 40 years of experience, we support cell therapies,
viral vectors, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, and vaccines with rapid,
regulator-accepted results.

Need standalone or integrated testing?

[ Explore Testing Services ][81]
* Analytical Development
  
  Our analytical scientists design, optimize and validate assays across the full lifecycle, from
  early-phase methods to commercial readiness. Services include potency, purity, identity and
  stability testing, aligned with ICH Q2 and global regulatory expectations. Integrated with
  development and manufacturing, we ensure reliable GMP performance across all modalities.
  
  [ Learn About Analytical Development ][82]
  1 / 8
* Assay Transfer
  
  Smooth assay transfer ensures continuity and reliability across sites and studies, maintaining
  consistency and accuracy. We deliver structured, data-driven transfers, including gap analysis,
  bridging studies and qualification/validation, in accordance with ICH Q2. Methods are supported
  across viral vectors, gene-edited cells, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), proteins and vaccines,
  ensuring seamless readiness for lot release, stability and comparability studies.
  
  [ See Assay Transfer Support ][83]
  2 / 8
* Biosafety Testing
  
  With more than 40 years of biosafety expertise, Minaris provides GMP-compliant sterility,
  mycoplasma, endotoxin, adventitious agent and replication-competent virus testing. Our specialized
  focus on CGT ensures risk-based strategies tailored to viral vectors, plasmids and packaging
  systems. Results are audit-ready and regulator-accepted, supporting IND, IMPD and BLA submissions
  worldwide.
  
  [ Explore Biosafety Testing ][84]
  3 / 8
* Cell Line Characterization
  
  We provide comprehensive, regulatory-compliant characterization of Master, Working and
  End-of-Production Cell Banks, including sterility, mycoplasma, endotoxin, retroviral and identity
  testing. Our services align with the guidelines of the ICH, FDA, EMA and PMDA, enabling the faster
  release of GMP cell banks and seamless integration into development and manufacturing workflows.
  
  [ Learn About Cell Line Characterization ][85]
  4 / 8
* Lot Release
  
  A reliable lot release ensures that therapies reach patients without delay. Minaris provides a
  comprehensive GMP testing panel across various modalities, including sterility, identity, potency,
  purity, residuals, RCL/rcAAV and more. With thousands of batches tested, our validated assays
  support global submissions and commercial approvals, minimizing risk and accelerating patient
  access.
  
  [ See Lot Release ][86]
  5 / 8
* Potency
  
  Potency is a critical quality attribute. We design and validate custom assays, ranging from
  cell-based functional studies and reporter gene assays to ELISA, PCR and transduction efficiency
  tests. All assays meet ICH Q2 standards, providing meaningful biological insights that satisfy
  regulators and support product release and lifecycle management.
  
  [ Explore Potency ][87]
  6 / 8
* Stability
  
  We deliver ICH Q1-compliant stability programs, including long-term, real-time, accelerated and
  ongoing studies. Our methods support all biologic and advanced therapy modalities, with
  submission-ready data for global regulators. By evaluating shelf life and storage conditions, we
  ensure that therapies maintain their safety, quality and efficacy throughout distribution and
  patient use.
  
  [ Learn About Stability ][88]
  7 / 8
* Viral Clearance
  
  A global leader with 3,000+ studies and zero regulatory rejections, Minaris designs viral
  clearance studies aligned with ICH Q5A(R2), FDA, EMA and WHO guidelines. Dedicated viral clearance
  suites with AKTA systems ensure rigorous validation across vectors, proteins and vaccines,
  safeguarding patient safety and accelerating regulatory approvals.
  
  [ See Viral Clearance ][89]
  8 / 8

* ### 质粒检测
  
  质粒（英语：Plasmid），是指在细胞的染色体或核区DNA之外，能够自主复制的DNA分子（字源：plasm为生殖质
  ，-id表示粒）。质粒与染色体最主要的区分是，质粒不是细胞生存所必需，染色体则是细胞生存必需的。
  [ 了解更多 ][92]
* ### 慢病毒
  
  慢病毒属（学名：Lentivirus）是逆转录病毒科下的一个属，此属病毒的特征是有较长的时间的潜伏期，例如人
  类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、猴免疫缺陷病毒(SIV)、马传染性贫血(EIA)、
  猫免疫缺陷病毒(FIV)都是慢病毒属，学名中“Lenti-”在拉丁文中有慢的意思。其共同特点为在其基因组的3'和5
  '有高度保守的LTR序列，其R区域用以整合酶的识别。
  [ 了解更多 ][93]
* ### 菌种检测
  
  [ 了解更多 ][94]
* ### 细胞检测
  
  我们的检测平台设有生物安全二级实验室，致力于提供高标准、高质量的生物质检服务。实验室严格遵循国家认
  证认可监督管理委员会（CMA）、中国合格评定国家认可委员会（CNAS）和良好生产规范（GMP）等质量体系，确
  保检测结果的准确性和可靠性。
  [ 了解更多 ][95]
* ### 外泌体检测
  
  外泌体是指包含了复杂 RNA 和蛋白质的小膜泡
  (30-150nm)，现今，其特指直径在40-100nm的盘状囊泡。1983年，外泌体首次于绵羊网织红细胞中被发现，
  1987年Johnstone将其命名为“exosome”。多种细胞在正常及病理状态下均可分泌外泌体。其主要来源于细胞内溶
  酶体微粒内陷形成的多囊泡体，经多囊泡体外膜与细胞膜融合后释放到胞外基质中 。
  [ 了解更多 ][96]

## 关于明鉴

### 深圳市明鉴检测专业技术有限公司（深圳市细胞与基因产品质量检测公共服务平台）总部位于深圳南山区高新

### 技术企业、专精特新企业等资质。深圳明鉴以“科学、公正、专业、高效”为质量方针，为细胞与基因治疗等生
### 物制品提供从方法开发、质量研究到检测放行的一站式质量解决方案——并能协助客户完成细胞与基因治疗类生
### 物医学新技术临床研究申报前的药学研究和非临床研究的所有工作，以创新的模式和服务内容“陪伴成长、共

## 检测平台

* ### 质粒检测
  
  质粒（英语：Plasmid），是指在细胞的染色体或核区DNA之外，能够自主复制的DNA分子（字源：plasm为生殖质
  ，-id表示粒）。质粒与染色体最主要的区分是，质粒不是细胞生存所必需，染色体则是细胞生存必需的。
  [ 了解更多 ][92]
* ### 慢病毒
  
  慢病毒属（学名：Lentivirus）是逆转录病毒科下的一个属，此属病毒的特征是有较长的时间的潜伏期，例如人
  类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、猴免疫缺陷病毒(SIV)、马传染性贫血(EIA)、
  猫免疫缺陷病毒(FIV)都是慢病毒属，学名中“Lenti-”在拉丁文中有慢的意思。其共同特点为在其基因组的3'和5
  '有高度保守的LTR序列，其R区域用以整合酶的识别。
  [ 了解更多 ][93]
* ### 菌种检测
  
  [ 了解更多 ][94]
* ### 细胞检测
  
  我们的检测平台设有生物安全二级实验室，致力于提供高标准、高质量的生物质检服务。实验室严格遵循国家认
  证认可监督管理委员会（CMA）、中国合格评定国家认可委员会（CNAS）和良好生产规范（GMP）等质量体系，确
  保检测结果的准确性和可靠性。
  [ 了解更多 ][95]
* ### 外泌体检测
  
  外泌体是指包含了复杂 RNA 和蛋白质的小膜泡
  (30-150nm)，现今，其特指直径在40-100nm的盘状囊泡。1983年，外泌体首次于绵羊网织红细胞中被发现，
  1987年Johnstone将其命名为“exosome”。多种细胞在正常及病理状态下均可分泌外泌体。其主要来源于细胞内溶
  酶体微粒内陷形成的多囊泡体，经多囊泡体外膜与细胞膜融合后释放到胞外基质中 。
  [ 了解更多 ][96]

# Manufacturing Excellence for Transformative Therapies

## Your Lifelong Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

[ Explore Our Services ][68]

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

[ Request A Consult ][69]
[commercial-capacity-logo]
Early development to commercial capacity
[flex-scalable-updated]
Flexible, scalable technology solutions
[ai-manufacturing-icon]
AI-enabled development and GMP manufacturing

## Seamless Transition from Early Development to Commercial Supply

Our expertise in advanced manufacturing services ensures the reliable execution needed to propel
your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

## Advancing Autologous Cell Therapies with Robust, Scalable Solutions

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate
closed-unit systems, AI models, and robotics to create robust, scalable, and efficient processes
tailored to your needs.

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate

hands. Our teams ensure you receive the highest level of services, transparency, and collaboration.

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. # Global Advanced
# Cell Therapy CDMO

Your Trusted Partner for Complex Cell Therapies from Development to Commercialization

[Explore Our Services][45]
Our Capabilities

## Bringing Your Cell Therapy Products to the Market

RoslinCT helps therapy developers turn complex cell therapy processes into phase-appropriate,
cGMP-ready programs across immunotherapies, gene-edited therapies, and stem cell/iPSC platforms.

We support both autologous and allogeneic manufacturing through flexible suite design, closed
processing, chain-of-identity controls, and tailored release testing for clinical and commercial
programs.

## Success Powered by Cutting-Edge Science

RoslinCT, as **one of the first in the world** to produce clinical-grade human pluripotent stem
cells, has a strong focus on science and innovation. In collaboration with Vertex Pharmaceuticals,
RoslinCT developed, from early process development through commercialization, the **First
CRISPR-Edited Cell Therapy Product, exa-cel** for the treatment of sickle cell disease and
transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia.

## Purpose-Built cGMP Manufacturing Facilities

[Partner with Us][54]
About RoslinCT

## Get to Know the Team and What We Stand for

Innovative Solutions. Trusted Partnerships. Life-changing Treatments.

Company Overview

Following the world-breaking first cloning of a mammal (**Dolly the Sheep**) at the Roslin Institute
within the University of Edinburgh (UK) in 1997, there was worldwide interest to access Roslin’s
technology and expertise. **RoslinCT was established in 2006 to translate this cutting-edge science
and apply it to the development of human medicines.**

[Read More][55]

Mission and Vision

To save the lives of patients by empowering our partners to efficiently progress cell & gene
therapies from development to commercialization, as their advanced CDMO partner of choice.

[Read More][56]

Leadership

We are a team of passionate professionals with decades of experience in the advanced cell & gene
therapy industry.

[Read More][57]

Scientific Advisory Board

The Scientific Advisory Board is comprised of cell and gene therapy pioneers

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation
][162]

## Partners for medicine and research

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

## Product highlights

[Highlight SMF-Pro-Website 1024x768px 0626]

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation

## Partners for medicine and research

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

# FBS, Human Serum & Cell Culture Media for Reliable Biotech

Premium fetal bovine serum, human sera and defined cell culture media — processed in Germany, backed
by full documentation and delivered with no minimum order and free test samples.

[View Products][289] [Contact Us][290]
[SeamlessBio — FBS, Human Serum and Cell Culture Media supplier Germany]

## Cell Culture Biologicals — Processed in Germany

FBS, human serum, albumin and defined cell culture media — sourced from qualified EU and US donor
centres, processed in our Passau facility, and delivered with full documentation and no minimum
order.

### 80+ Biologicals & Reagents

FBS in 9 grades, 10 human serum variants, BSA, HSA, defined cell culture media and DMPK transporter
kits — comparable breadth to PAN-Biotech and Capricorn Scientific, from one EU contact.

### Processed in Germany — Full Documentation

All sera processed at our Passau facility with sterile filtration, endotoxin and mycoplasma testing.
CoA, CoO, Donor Screening and TSE/BSE statement with every lot. IVDR documentation on request.

### Lot Reservation — No Prepayment

Reserve your validated FBS or human serum lot for up to 12 months — no prepayment required. Call off
as needed. Essential for IVD calibrator programmes and ATMP development where lot consistency is
critical.

### ISO-Aligned Quality & GMP-Pathway Options

Quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 13485. GMP-pathway FBS (gamma irradiated, heat
inactivated) and Near-GMP human serum documentation available for ATMP and biopharma manufacturing.

Product Groups

## Explore Our Main Product Categories

Fetal bovine serum, human sera, albumin, defined cell culture media, single-use bioprocessing bags
and DMPK transporter kits — for cell culture research, IVD diagnostics and biopharmaceutical
manufacturing.

[

### Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS)

9 grades — Standard to GMP-pathway. USA, Australian, New Zealand and South American origin. The
reference serum for mammalian cell culture.

][291] [

### Cell Culture Media

NaivaCore naive stem cell medium (EU-exclusive HENSM), OrganoMedium, serum-free HEK293 and CHO
media, and custom CDMO formulation.

][292] [

### Human Sera & Plasma

10 variants — Standard, Male, Type AB, OTC, OTC AB Male and Delipidated. EU & US donors, processed
in Germany. The xeno-free alternative to FBS for human cell culture.

][293] [

### Single-Use Bioprocessing

2D bags, 3D bioreactor bags, rocker bags (10/20/50L), tank liners and stainless steel container
systems. USP Class VI, gamma-sterilised, 150 mL to 1000+ L.

][294] [

### Albumin & Proteins

BSA, HSA and recombinant HSA across 4 grades each — for serum-free media, DMPK assay buffers,
cryoprotection and IVD calibrator stabilisation.

lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

As a recognized world leader in pluripotent stem cell banking and cell testing and characterization

and reliable characterization testing.

### ^{Latest News}

## WiCell Expands Stem Cell Catalog with New Parkinson’s Disease Collections

WiCell is proud to announce the addition of two new stem cell collections from the Michael J. Fox
Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (MJFF) and Aligning Science Across Parkinson’s (ASAP) to
its [catalog][57]: the ESCAPE LRRK2 Cell Line Collection, and the Isogenic Stem Cell Collection to
Research Parkinson’s Disease (iSCORE-PD).

These disease-relevant collections will enable researchers to uncover new insights into disease
mechanisms and identify therapeutic targets for Parkinson’s disease. This collaboration also
establishes a centralized online repository, ensuring researchers can easily locate and request
Parkinson’s disease relevant iPSC lines.

 

[Read More][58]

**“Fate Therapeutics has worked with WiCell over the past decade. WiCell has characterized cell
lines for Fate, and they have delivered high quality study results as well as outstanding and
knowledgeable service and technical support.”**

Bob Valamehr, Ph.D.
*President, Research & Development, Fate Therepeutics*

## WiCell Expands Stem Cell Catalog with New Parkinson’s Disease Collections

WiCell is proud to announce the addition of two new stem cell collections from the Michael J. Fox
Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (MJFF) and Aligning Science Across Parkinson’s (ASAP) to
its [catalog][57]: the ESCAPE LRRK2 Cell Line Collection, and the Isogenic Stem Cell Collection to
Research Parkinson’s Disease (iSCORE-PD).

These disease-relevant collections will enable researchers to uncover new insights into disease
mechanisms and identify therapeutic targets for Parkinson’s disease. This collaboration also
establishes a centralized online repository, ensuring researchers can easily locate and request
Parkinson’s disease relevant iPSC lines.

# Zelle® | Send and receive money directly to and from your bank account

## Here for you, so you can be there for them^{SM}

With Zelle®, the money goes directly into your bank account. That means it's easy to get paid back
or send money to a friend. 


Pause Video playing

Send money to friends and family quickly, even if they bank somewhere different than you do.¹ The
money goes directly into their bank account, so you can focus on what really counts – being there
for the people you care about.

## See if your bank or credit union offers Zelle®

Get Started

## See if your bank or credit union offers Zelle®

## Banks

Search for your bank or credit union

### Zelle® is already in over 2,400 banking apps

[View All Banks][24]

## Digital Payment Education

We’re here to empower you with knowledge on using Zelle® safely and avoiding common scams. Explore
resources, test your knowledge and get new tips on how to keep your money safe in a digital world.

[Learn More][25]

## Tips for Safer Payments

Digital payments continue to grow across the U.S. And with issues like identity theft and other
cybercrimes on the rise, it’s important to know what you can do to help protect yourself.

[Learn More][26]

## Understanding Fraud and Scams

As a consumer or small business owner, it’s important to understand how fraud and scams are defined
because there may be differences in the protections offered by your bank or credit union.

[Learn More][27]

## Partnerships

Zelle® is proud to partner with Los Angeles Football Club as a Golden Boot Club corporate partner
and the official peer-to-peer payment provider of LAFC. Through the Zelle and LAFC partnership, fans
can enjoy an enhanced matchday experience at BMO Stadium, including exclusive benefits through LAFC
Gold, the Zelle® Grand Lobby, and in-stadium moments like “Settle up in the 70th.” Together, Zelle
and LAFC are also committed to giving back to the Los Angeles community through charitable
initiatives that support local organizations and create meaningful impact across LA each year.

[Learn More][28]
PreviousNext

## Ways to use Zelle®

Split the cost for the late-night study break pizza.

Pay your fave nail tech for an unforgettable manicure.

Get paid back for being the best “team Dad” this weekend.

Send your aunt money for a birthday shopping spree.

## Learn more about the Zelle® network

[Visit Our Help Center][29]
[About Zelle®][30]
[Enrolling with Zelle®][31]
[Using Zelle®][32]
[Your Zelle® Profile][33]
[ Using Zelle® with a Small Business Account][34]
[ Disbursements with Zelle®][35]

^{1 }Zelle® is available in over 2,400 banking and credit union apps. To send or receive money with
Zelle®, both parties must have an eligible checking or savings account. Transactions sent to
enrolled users typically occur within minutes. Check with your financial institution.

^{2 }Based on a Q1 2026 survey of financial institutions offering Zelle® to their customers, 99.40%
of consumer saving and checking accounts linked to Zelle® do not charge a fee to send, receive, or
request money.

^{3 }For more information about Zelle® Tag, [see here][36].

^{4 }Payment requests can only be sent to enrolled Zelle® users.
